question: Who became the new CEO of OLIPOP in August 2026?

hits.title: Olipop, the US gut health soda brand, has unveiled a leadership change as it prepares for its next stage of its growth.
hits.snippet: [hires] Olipop, Inc. hires Webb as chief executive officer. In a Linkedin announcement the company said that Olipop continues to grow in "scale, complexity, and reach" with the appointment of Webb, who has previously worked at Unilever and most recently for Electrolit, the hydration beverage brand, as CEO "marking an important moment in this evolution."
hits.summary: Olipop, Inc. hires Webb as chief executive officer.

hits.title: Olipop prepares for growth with new CEO.
hits.snippet: [hires | 2026-12-08] Olipop, Inc. will hire Christian Patiño Webb as chief executive officer on Dec 8th '26. OAKLAND, CALIF. - Functional soda company Olipop has named Christian Patiño Webb as its new chief executive officer to support its next stage of growth.
hits.summary: Olipop, Inc. will hire Christian Patiño Webb as chief executive officer on Dec 8th '26.
